title: ADR decisions
description: The normative decisions made by a single ADR.

slug.description: Stable identifier, unique within the ADR. Never reuse or rename once accepted.

title.description: Short human-readable name for the decision.

category.description: The single broad area this decision belongs to; the handbook is organized by category.

strength.description: RFC 2119 requirement level. Required unless this is a rescission record.

statement.description: The normative decision text, or for a rescission record, why the target is withdrawn. Markdown allowed.

rationale.description: Optional short justification specific to this decision. Markdown allowed.

supersedes.description: The decision (in an earlier ADR) this one replaces or, with rescinded: true, withdraws. Takes effect once this decision's ADR is accepted.

adr.description: Folder name of the ADR holding the superseded decision.

rescinded.description: True marks this entry as a rescission record: the decision named in 'supersedes' is withdrawn with no replacement.

tags.description: Free-form labels for grouping and search: lower case, with hyphens or dots between parts (e.g. 'link-layer', 'v1.x').
